purpose: Build the spatially ready accident point layer from accident_master and keep unmatched or zero-coordinate cases explicit.
validation_rule: Validate required spatial columns, count non-zero coordinates, confirm CRS metadata and keep a separate unmatched bucket.
dependency_note: Consumes the accident-level master built in M3.

purpose: Create the canonical drivable edge/node layers that will become the routing graph backbone.
validation_rule: Validate topology basics, CRS consistency and graph suitability for edge-based routing.
dependency_note: This is the main blocker right now: no canonical routable network is stored in the repo.

purpose: Snap or match each accident point to the canonical graph edge, keeping distance/error diagnostics.
validation_rule: Validate one best edge per accident, unmatched share, distance thresholds and auditable match quality fields.
dependency_note: Direct matching should use geometry first; any tramo/sensor crosswalk is auxiliary, not a substitute.

purpose: Aggregate matched accidents by edge and time window to build historical counts and severity summaries.
validation_rule: Validate that aggregation keys are edge_id and time window, not raw coordinates or sensor ids.
dependency_note: Depends on completion of previous spatial stages.

purpose: Join denominator or exposure proxies to avoid treating raw counts as final risk.
validation_rule: Validate denominator quality, missing exposure coverage and rate stability before scoring.
dependency_note: Exposure input is still missing and must stay separate from raw historical counts.

purpose: Combine historical frequency, severity and optional smoothing into a preliminary edge-level historical block.
validation_rule: Validate clear separation from baseline/contextual signals and do not convert the score into final routing cost yet.
dependency_note: Depends on completion of previous spatial stages.
